hypothesis: Short-window breakouts and small trough rebounds repeatedly reopen positions inside a larger decline. Require a stock to establish a fresh highest observed close for new risk, preserve existing units until a bounded peak loss, and keep stopped capital in cash. This deliberately exchanges early bottom participation for fewer failed recoveries without using future troughs or symbol/date switches.

fixed_rules.entry: fresh running highest observed close after minimum history; no pre-2023 bars
fixed_rules.exit: close <= observed running peak * (1-stop), or stale quote
fixed_rules.ranking: mean causal 30/60/120-session log momentum with since-observed fallback
fixed_rules.capital: retain intact economic units; allocate only on fresh record evidence; never recycle proceeds on an exit close; entry/drift concentration bounds unchanged

selection_objective: mean(log(wealth / matched buy_hold wealth) - 0.75 * max_drawdown - 0.002 * max(0, orders_per_year - 20))
execution: Unchanged daily-close decision / next-open fill engine and costs.
limits: Retrospective diagnostic family. Preserve all prior directional, fresh-entry and shadow-guard failures. Training rank is not economic acceptance.
